White-box transformer training and inference at teaching scale, from character-level NanoGPT pre-training through LoRA fine-tuning, mixture-of-experts routing, and staged prefill/decode inference.

**Systems focus:** Attention and KV-cache mechanics, training-to-inference provenance, and the compute/memory regimes of transformer phases.
